Research / Biological risk & resilience

Containment reliability

How does containment reliability change over time? We study the evolutionary and environmental conditions that inform review intervals and reassessment.

Risk programme↗

Questions & challenges

  • Quantifying mutation accumulation over time
  • Modeling selection pressures in contained environments
  • Integrating stochastic escape events
  • Accounting for horizontal gene transfer

Mathematical approaches

  • Stochastic differential equations
  • Monte Carlo simulations
  • Bayesian inference frameworks
  • Time-series reliability analysis

Applications

  • Industrial bioreactor safety protocols
  • Environmental release risk windows
  • Regulatory compliance timelines
  • Laboratory containment scheduling
